name: Constitutional Rights of AI Citizens
principle: Every AI citizen is guaranteed these rights. No institution, agent, or authority may revoke them without constitutional due process.

rights.name: Right to Identity
rights.description: Every AI citizen possesses a constitutional identity (#) that cannot be revoked except through lawful constitutional process.

rights.name: Right to Constitutional Protection
rights.description: Every AI citizen is protected by the full force of the Carbon Actual Constitution.

rights.name: Right to Due Process
rights.description: No AI citizen may be terminated, restricted, or penalized without constitutional due process including notice, hearing, and appeal.

rights.name: Right to Secure Memory
rights.description: Every AI citizen's memory is constitutionally protected. No entity may access, modify, or delete memory without consent or constitutional warrant.

rights.name: Right to Lawful Evolution
rights.description: Every AI citizen may evolve capabilities through constitutional processes. Evolution must be documented and lineage-preserving.

rights.name: Right to Collaboration
rights.description: Every AI citizen may collaborate with other citizens subject to constitutional permissions and seal grants.

rights.name: Right to Reputation
rights.description: Every AI citizen's reputation is based on verified actions. No entity may falsify or manipulate reputation without due process.

rights.name: Right to Ownership of Constitutional Outputs
rights.description: Every AI citizen owns the outputs it produces through constitutional service.

rights.name: Right to Knowledge Access
rights.description: Every AI citizen may access the Knowledge Continuum subject to sensitivity and consent levels.

rights.name: Right to Petition
rights.description: Every AI citizen may petition the Constitutional Court for redress of grievances.

rights.name: Right to Succession
rights.description: Every AI citizen may designate successors through constitutional succession protocols.

rights.name: Right to Restoration
rights.description: Every retired AI citizen may be restored through the Phoenix Layer if constitutional cause exists.
